title: oreobatus deliciosus subsp. neomexicanus
intro: Oreobatus deliciosus subsp. neomexicanus, commonly known as New Mexican penstemon, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is prized for its vibrant purple flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The New Mexican penstemon is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and wounds. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
